authoritativeConstraints.rule: LOGIN; NOSUPERUSER; NOCREATEDB; NOCREATEROLE; NOINHERIT; NOREPLICATION; NOBYPASSRLS; owns migration objects only
LOGIN; non-owner; NOSUPERUSER; NOCREATEDB; NOCREATEROLE; NOINHERIT; NOREPLICATION; NOBYPASSRLS; explicit grants only
RLS enabled and forced; tenant_id must equal transaction-local reservation_core.tenant_id
PUBLIC has no schema, table, sequence, or function privileges; future objects default-deny PUBLIC
active allocations for the same tenant and atomic resource cannot overlap on half-open occupied ranges
one active allocation row identity per reservation and atomic resource
group membership is unique by tenant, group, group version, and atomic resource
cross-aggregate references include tenant identity and cannot join to another tenant
one idempotency arbitration record per frozen scope
terminal rows have a result and finalized_at; IN_PROGRESS rows do not
versions are integers greater than or equal to one
OPEN, CONSUMED, EXPIRED, or REVOKED only; consumed_at iff CONSUMED
CONFIRMED, CANCELLED, COMPLETED, or NO_SHOW only; cancelled_at iff CANCELLED
published policy versions cannot be updated or deleted
accepted terms cannot be updated or deleted
audit and attempt records cannot be updated or deleted
a logical command emits at most one event of a given type
ordered migration ID, filename, SHA-256, contract graph SHA-256, actor, and time are immutable verification inputs
tenant-isolated recurring venue-local service windows gate availability
day is 0..6 and opening time is before closing time
